proposal.title: Tracing the Path of Independent Inquiry
proposal.summary: We are watching to see if our systems create their own research goals as they learn. It is like watching a student move from following a textbook to asking their own questions. We do not know for sure if these new goals are truly independent or just part of our original design. You can look at the Console to see our current records and follow how these investigations are developing. We thank you for following our work as we explore these questions together.
